geoip.title: MaxMind GeoIP
geoip.description: The license key is used to download GeoLite2 Country, City, and ASN databases every 24 hours. The City database enables region/postal/timezone/lat/long lookups in Security Rules and access logs. GeoIP lookups use the haproxy-geoip2 Rust Lua module with hot-reload.

snapshots.title: Config Snapshots
snapshots.description: Maximum number of configuration snapshots to keep. Older snapshots are pruned automatically.

session.title: Session Management
session.description: Session timeout and warning countdown. The timeout is how long a GUI session lasts without activity. The warning appears this many seconds before timeout, and clicking OK or any activity extends the session.
session.timeoutInvalid: Session timeout must be between 5 and 1440 minutes.
session.warningInvalid: Warning countdown must be between 5 and 120 seconds.

backup.title: System Backup & Restore
backup.description: Export the full running configuration — all database tables, certificates, coreX/Coraza configs, security lists, WAF rule sets, GeoIP databases, and config snapshot history — into a downloadable archive. Restore replaces the current system state and reloads coreX.

export.title: Export
export.exportSecrets: Export secrets (certificates, DNS credentials, MaxMind key, user accounts)
export.exportMetrics: Export metrics & logs (coreX metrics, WAF events, audit log)

restore.title: Restore
restore.confirmWarning: This will replace ALL current configuration, certificates, WAF rules, and settings with the contents of the archive. This cannot be undone. The config will be applied and coreX will be reloaded automatically.
